# ATS Resume Optimizer

> Free AI-powered ATS resume checker and optimizer for job seekers. Paste a resume and a job description to get a compatibility score, AI HR-style feedback, and a one-click rewrite tailored to the job post.

## What it does

- **ATS compatibility score (simulated, not a real ATS score):** 60% JD exact-keyword coverage + 40% plain-text parseability (contact info extraction, date format consistency, encoding issues, reasonable length).
- **AI HR-style review** across 4 dimensions: writing strength, quantification & results, experience specificity, role alignment — each with a score, one-line comment, and a quote from the resume as evidence.
- **One-click AI rewrite** that weaves the JD's missing exact keywords into the candidate's real experience, with a word-level diff (green = added, red strikethrough = removed) so every change can be verified before use.
- **Free quotas:** 5 AI reviews/day, 2 AI rewrites/day per IP. No signup required.

## Key facts

- JD matching is **exact-word only**: no synonyms, no stemming, no term mapping. "K8s" does not match "Kubernetes"; "Amazon Web Services" does not match "AWS".
- The rewrite prompt **forbids fabricating** projects, companies, job titles, certificates, or new numbers/metrics. It may amplify the candidate's real contributions with reasonable wording.
- The 4-dimension AI review runs on a small open model; scores are directional indicators, not precise measurements.
- Scores are deterministic for identical inputs (fixed sampling settings).

## Who it's for

Job seekers — especially in tech roles — tailoring their resume to a specific job posting, and anyone who wants to check whether their resume contains an employer's exact keywords.

## URL

https://checkats.online
